claims.claim: The billing referent billing:Meridian Energy Partners LLC corresponds to the billed name Meridian Energy Partners LLC in billing records.
Contract document MSA-MER-2024 names Meridian Energy Partners LLC as its Counterparty.
Meridian Energy Partners invoices are described as the advisory retainer under MSA-MER-2024.
billing:Meridian Energy Partners LLC and contract:MSA-MER-2024 denote the same legal counterparty.
billing:Meridian Energy Partners LLC and contract:MSA-MER-2024 denote distinct legal counterparties.

support_claim: The packet links the billing name and the contract counterparty field to Meridian Energy Partners LLC and associates invoices with MSA-MER-2024, but provides no evidence that the referents billing:Meridian Energy Partners LLC and contract:MSA-MER-2024 themselves denote the same legal counterparty.
